description: Founder lookup for up to 10 companies in ONE call - always prefer this over calling frontrun_company_founders once per company. Serves verified cached founder data in about a second. Each founder's "handle" field is their X handle - present it as @handle. Companies returned with resolution_status "resolving" have live discovery running in the background: retry just those via frontrun_company_founders in about a minute. Companies with founders found draw on usage; misses are free.

max_credits.description: Optional spend ceiling for this one call. Fails closed: if the call could use more, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

name: frontrun_founders_batch
